newsitem.title: KUWAIT: French troops start Kuwait wargames.
newsitem.headline: French troops start Kuwait wargames.

text.p: Kuwaiti and French troops began on Sunday a week-long joint sea, air and ground military exercise, the French embassy said.
The deployment in Kuwait of some 1,000 French troops and military hardware, including vessels and attack aircraft, was completed on Saturday ahead of the "Pearl of the West 96" exercise.
France was a key member of the U.S.-led military coalition which defeated Iraq in the 1991 Gulf War, ending Baghdad's seven-month occupation of oil-rich Kuwait.
French officials said the exercise, part of a 1992 defence pact between the two states, shows France's continued commitment to the defence of Kuwait.
In September Kuwait's main ally the United States sent added troops and weapons, including Stealth bombers, to Kuwait to deter what officials called renewed Iraqi threats.
